name: confessions
description: Independent test vectors for /confessions anonymous mesh board (LCI DTN). Derived from RFC 7252 CoAP examples, RFC 8613 OSCORE (cross-referenced from oscore.json), and RFC 8428 SenML. No LICHEN implementation used as oracle. Validates POST submissions with OSCORE ciphertext, GET polls with SenML response, rejection cases, and plaintext fallback.

vectors.name: post_confession_plaintext
vectors.description: POST /confessions with plaintext SenML message. Uses RFC 8428 SenML-CBOR (Content-Format 112) with a single string value. Oracle: pyca/cryptography CBOR encoding.

vectors.name: post_confession_oscore_wrapped
vectors.description: POST /confessions with OSCORE-protected SenML payload. Ciphertext derived from oscore.json rfc8613_c1 key derivation (sender_id empty, recipient_id 0x01) with seq=20. Validation: decrypt produces same plaintext as post_confession_plaintext.

vectors.name: get_confessions_empty
vectors.description: GET /confessions returns SenML response with count 0. Uses RFC 8428 example format adapted for confessions board status. Oracle: pyca/cryptography SenML CBOR encoding.

vectors.name: get_confessions_with_entries
vectors.description: GET /confessions returns SenML response with count > 0 after POST.

vectors.name: rate_limit_rejection_confessions
vectors.description: Rapid POST rejected due to rate limit (5.03 per RFC 7252 §5.1.5.3). Spec: CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_DEADDROP_RATE_LIMIT_MS default 30000ms per peer. Oracle: no code base.

vectors.name: empty_post_rejected
vectors.description: POST /confessions with empty payload returns 4.00 Bad Request.

vectors.name: confession_with_senml_timestamp
vectors.description: POST /confessions with SenML including timestamp (RFC 8428 base time + relative). CBOR: {bt: 1711324800, e:[{v:"hello"}]}.
